summary: AcadeMedia AB (publ) operates as an independent education provider in Sweden, Finland, Norway, the Netherlands, and Germany. The company operates through four segments: Preschool & International, Primary Schools, Secondary School, and Adult Education. It operates preschools, primary schools, upper secondary schools, and adult education units. The company was formerly known as Anew Learning AB. AcadeMedia AB (publ) was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
